issue_request: FHIR-34502 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-I. It asked to change TestReport.testScript from a normal RESTful Reference to a canonical reference because TestScript has a canonical URL; the resolution accepted the canonical type and noted that TestReport should not be constrained to only reports of TestScript-defined tests.
initial_application: PR #1767, implemented by 9dabc46e04 and merged by 4961c84ad2, changed source/testreport/structuredefinition-TestReport.xml from code=Reference to code=canonical and updated the TestReport example from a nested Reference to a canonical value. That application did not update the FHIR ModelInfo Library example.
additional_context: The authoritative TestReport resource source was later removed from the core checkout by f9a44787c4 as part of moving TestScript, TestPlan, and TestReport to the FHIR Testing IG. Current source/fhir.ini and ballot-intro.html point to the Testing IG, whose current TestReport JSON already has TestReport.testScript as canonical. Core still publishes the FHIR ModelInfo XML through Library examples and publish.ini, and that ModelInfo still exposed TestReport.testScript as FHIR.Reference before this reconciliation. The Jira resolution's optionality/cardinality wording is not represented in ModelInfo; any desired cardinality follow-up now belongs in the Testing IG.
reconciliation: Changed source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml so TestReport.testScript uses FHIR.canonical and refreshed source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml so the embedded Library.data payload matches the standalone ModelInfo XML.
